panels.title: 通用雕塑家遇到医学几何
panels.visual_metaphor: A generic 3D sculptor confronting the domain gap of anatomical geometry
panels.prompt: Recurring blue research robot moves from generic text-to-3D sculptures toward four red anatomical blueprints that require medical-domain adaptation.

panels.title: 医学网格先过数据审计
panels.visual_metaphor: A mesh quality-control bench exposing label errors, holes, and imbalance
panels.prompt: Same robot audits four unequal collections of anatomical meshes, removing a misclassified brain and flagging a heart mesh with holes.

panels.title: 冻结编码端，只微调生成端
panels.visual_metaphor: A frozen transmitter feeding latent crystals into a trainable diffusion generator
panels.prompt: Same robot operates a pipeline whose transmitter is frozen in ice while only the connected diffusion generator is adjusted for medical shapes.

panels.title: 损失下降，但证据边界仍在
panels.visual_metaphor: A lower latent-error gauge separated from unresolved anatomy validation
panels.prompt: Same robot observes a real latent-loss improvement while a transparent barrier reveals missing geometry, topology, landmark, and clinician checks.

panels.title: 锁定可信几何，再生成表达层
panels.visual_metaphor: A flexible generative presentation shell built around locked verified geometry
panels.prompt: Same robot adds controllable appearance and explanatory presentation around an immutable golden verified liver scaffold.
